rows.name: P0.3: V3 in-transaction record hook not called
examples: P0.3-crash: a crash right after the payment commit must not leave the challenge reusable or the payment without evidence
P0.3-race: two Vault workers interleaving on one database admit at most one payment per challenge, never a payment without evidence
P0.3-faults: a crash at every write inside the proposal leaves either nothing or the complete record
P0.3-bypass: an owner paycap that reaches the V3/V5 core without the V6 verification is refused (fail closed)

rows.name: P0.3: core reached without V6 verification accepted
examples: P0.3-bypass: an owner paycap that reaches the V3/V5 core without the V6 verification is refused (fail closed)

rows.name: P0.2: prepared command not compared to the Root rebuild
examples: P0.2-forged: commands the Root would not produce are refused before any fingerprint prompt

examples: P0.2-forged: commands the Root would not produce are refused before any fingerprint prompt

rows.name: P0.2: gate shows the console digest instead of the rebuilt text
examples: P0.2-display: the gate window shows the command rebuilt from Root (type, scope, hold), not a digest prefix
P0.2-substitution: a console that shows FREEZE but asks the gate for a HOLD_RELEASE gets a window that says HOLD_RELEASE

rows.name: P0.2: payment summaryDigest not recomputed
examples: P0.2-summary: an approval whose summaryDigest is not the canonical Root summary is refused (displayed amount 1 instead of 3)
P0.2-summary: an approval whose summaryDigest is not the canonical Root summary is refused (displayed another recipient)
P0.2-summary: an approval whose summaryDigest is not the canonical Root summary is refused (displayed a later approval expiry)
P0.2-summary: an approval whose summaryDigest is not the canonical Root summary is refused (displayed weaker assurance)
